name: Terminal
description: Embedded interactive terminal (xterm.js + PTY) for the work panel. Opens a login shell in the current workspace (over ssh for remote projects).
author: local

commands.title: 结束所有 tmux 后台会话

settings.title: 按住 ⌘ 才打开链接
settings.description: 开启后，点击终端里的链接需要同时按住 ⌘（或 Ctrl），避免选中文字时误触打开浏览器。右键菜单里的“打开链接”不受影响。

settings.title: 粘贴时把多行折成单行
settings.description: 开启后，⌘V 和右键“粘贴”会把换行替换成空格，避免多行命令粘进去就被执行；右键菜单里会改为提供“粘贴（保留换行）”。

settings.title: 自动切换到英文输入法
settings.description: 终端获得键盘焦点时切到英文输入法，离开时切回原来的输入法。仅 macOS，需要先安装 im-select（brew install im-select）。

settings.title: 打开终端面板的快捷键
settings.description: 在对话窗口里按下这个组合键，把终端面板切到前台。默认 ⌘T（Windows / Linux 是 Ctrl+T）；终端面板内部的 ⌘T 仍是新建标签。

settings.title: 用 tmux 保持终端会话
settings.description: 开启后，每个标签跑在插件专用的 tmux 服务里，重载插件、重启宿主后 shell 和里面的程序仍在，下次打开自动接回。需要已安装 tmux，找不到时新建标签会报错。会加载你自己的 ~/.tmux.conf，没有该文件时使用一份最小配置。在命令面板运行“结束所有 tmux 后台会话”可清理遗留的会话。

settings.title: 远程项目使用的主机
settings.description: 留空即可：远程项目总是连它自己绑定的主机。只有读不到项目绑定时才会用到这里：填主机的名称（如 macmini）或 hostKey，必须是 PI-Desktop 里以 SSH 方式添加的主机。它不会覆盖项目的绑定，也不会在没有绑定时去猜主机。

en.name: Side Terminal
en.description: Embedded interactive terminal (xterm.js + PTY) for the work panel. Opens a login shell in the current workspace (over ssh for remote projects).
en.safetyNotes: Starts an interactive login shell (your $SHELL) inside a PTY via a bundled python3 relay, spawned with an argument array and no shell string. The shell has the same OS rights as you, and commands you type run unrestricted. The plugin itself sends no network requests, reads no credentials and writes no files of its own (the remote-project case described below is the one exception: it starts the system ssh client); the only thing it stores is the terminal font size you set with Cmd +/-, saved through the host into this plugin's own settings. Optional and off by default: the input-method switch changes the macOS input source to English while the terminal has keyboard focus and restores the previous one afterwards, by spawning the optional im-select helper. Clicking an http(s) link in the terminal only hands the URL to your default browser. The clipboard is read only when you paste (right-click menu or Cmd+V) and written only when you copy a selection; the clipboard text is never stored or sent anywhere except into the terminal you pasted into. Optional and off by default (tmuxMode): when you turn on tmuxMode, each tab runs inside a tmux server the plugin starts on its own private socket (tmux -L pi-terminal; tmux loads your own ~/.tmux.conf, and only if you have none a small fixed config is piped over stdin), and closing the panel or unloading the plugin only detaches the tmux client - the shell and anything running in it keep running in the background, under your user, until you close the tab, exit the shell or run the 'End all tmux background sessions' command. The tmux binary is only ever run with an argument array. Remote projects: when the current project lives on a remote host, the shell is started on that host by the system ssh client (argument array, BatchMode, so it never asks for a password or passphrase and never falls back to a local shell). To find the host the plugin reads the host list that PI-Desktop keeps (~/.pi-desktop/remote-hosts.json) and uses only its SSH connection fields (address, port, user and the path of the key file; the file also holds encrypted device tokens, which are neither kept nor used, and the key itself is never read by the plugin) and runs a read-only query of the project's host binding in ~/.pi-desktop/pi.sqlite through the sqlite3 command; ssh then authenticates with your own key file or ssh-agent. Before a tab is opened the plugin makes one short ssh call to check that the host answers, that tmux exists (tmux tabs) and that the project directory can be entered. The 'End all tmux background sessions' command also ends every session on the plugin's private tmux socket on that host, including ones another computer of yours opened there. Commands you type there run unrestricted with your rights on the remote host; with tmuxMode on, the tmux sessions live on that host (same private socket) and keep running there until you close the tab or run the 'End all tmux background sessions' command. Requires python3 on PATH.

zh-CN.name: 侧边终端工具
zh-CN.description: 工作面板内置的交互式终端（xterm.js + PTY），在当前工作区打开登录 shell（远程项目通过 ssh 在远程主机上打开）。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 通过随插件附带的 python3 中继在 PTY 中启动交互式登录 shell（使用 $SHELL），以参数数组方式启动，不拼接 shell 字符串。该 shell 与你拥有相同的系统权限，你输入的命令不受限制。插件自身不发起网络请求、不读取凭据，自己不写入文件（下文的远程项目是唯一例外：会调用系统 ssh 客户端）；唯一会保存的是你用 ⌘+ / ⌘- 调整的终端字号，由宿主存进本插件自己的设置里。输入法切换为可选功能，默认关闭：开启后终端获得键盘焦点时会把 macOS 输入法切到英文，离开时恢复原输入法，通过调用可选的 im-select 工具实现。点击终端中的 http(s) 链接只会把网址交给默认浏览器。剪贴板仅在你粘贴（右键菜单或 ⌘V）时读取、在你复制选区时写入，内容不会被保存，也不会发送到你粘贴的那个终端以外的任何地方。可选功能，默认关闭（tmuxMode）：开启 tmuxMode 后，每个标签会跑在插件自己启动的 tmux 服务里（私有 socket：tmux -L pi-terminal；由 tmux 加载你自己的 ~/.tmux.conf，仅在你没有该文件时才通过标准输入传入一份固定的最小配置）。关闭面板或卸载插件只会让 tmux 客户端脱离，shell 及其中运行的程序会继续在后台以你的身份运行，直到你关闭标签、退出 shell，或运行“结束所有 tmux 后台会话”命令。tmux 始终以参数数组方式调用。远程项目：当前项目位于远程主机时，由系统 ssh 客户端在该主机上启动 shell（参数数组方式，BatchMode，不会询问密码或口令，也不会退回到本地 shell）。为了确定主机，插件会读取 PI-Desktop 保存的主机列表（~/.pi-desktop/remote-hosts.json），只使用其中的 SSH 连接字段（地址、端口、用户名和密钥文件路径；该文件里还有加密的设备令牌，插件不保存也不使用，密钥本身插件也不会读取），并通过 sqlite3 命令对 ~/.pi-desktop/pi.sqlite 做只读查询，取得该项目绑定的主机；之后 ssh 使用你自己的密钥文件或 ssh-agent 认证。打开标签前，插件会先发起一次很短的 ssh 调用，检查主机能否连通、tmux 是否存在（tmux 标签）以及项目目录能否进入。“结束所有 tmux 后台会话”命令也会结束该主机上插件私有 tmux socket 里的所有会话，包括你另一台电脑在那里打开的会话。你在其中输入的命令以你在远程主机上的权限运行，不受限制；开启 tmuxMode 时，tmux 会话在该主机上（同一个私有 socket），直到你关闭标签或运行“结束所有 tmux 后台会话”命令才会结束。需要 PATH 中有 python3。
